headline: China publishes State Council guidance on AI and employment adaptation
summary: The State Council General Office opinion is dated 16 October 2026 and was publicly announced on 23 October. An official Chinese government-portal excerpt identifies it as Guobanfa [2026] No. 29 and displays selected provisions on AI-related employment services, worker protections and employment-risk monitoring. The official Hubei HRSS-hosted Xinhua announcement describes six areas and 18 tasks. This establishes stated national policy direction, not implementation or measured labor-market effects.
